Tame the Meter!

Back to quest database

Community label for the objective that distinguishes the basic ground panel from the roof version.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Work through the objectives

  1. Open the phone's energy meter and inspect daily usage.
  2. Buy solar panel blueprints from Meriam for the panels you need.
  3. Place and finish building the panels.
  4. Check that the ranch meets the electricity-efficiency objective.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • The final check is electricity efficiency, not simply owning one panel. This configuration gives no fixed panel count or numeric efficiency target.
  • Earlier player reports recommend the basic ground panel. The build checks a solar-item family; this alone does not verify that roof panels work.

Sources and boundary

  • Two players independently confirmed that the objective needs the basic ground solar panel. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Solar Panel Quest · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • The roof solar panel does not satisfy this objective even though it is also a solar panel. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Solar Panel Quest · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • The retained confirmations say one correctly placed ground panel is sufficient; exact quest title and prerequisite timing remain unverified. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Solar Panel Quest · Build: 0.8.10.x

These steps come from the recorded game build and public sources; missing rewards, prerequisites and unlock timing are not filled in.
